Sections render in exact order: me-hero, me-highlights, me-overview, me-how, me-coverage, me-topology, me-industries, me-why, me-stories, me-cta, me-faq, site-footer. Images /metro/hero.png (1863x844), /metro/overview.png (1506x1045), /metro/diagram.webp (2000x667) load (naturalWidth>0); me-topology-card-0..2 use /metro/topology.webp as CSS background. Labeled empty slots present: image-slot-me-map, image-slot-me-ind-1..6, image-slot-me-why, image-slot-me-story, image-slot-me-cta. Contact modal pre-selects 'Metro Ethernet' from me-hero-quote-btn, me-hero-team-btn, me-cta-quote-btn, me-cta-sales-btn and header-contact-btn on this route; form submit shows sonner toast and closes modal. FAQ Radix accordion me-faq-trigger-0..4 opens with data-state=open, single-open behaviour verified (opening trigger-2 collapses trigger-0). EN/ID toggle via header-lang-toggle switches hero title to 'Konektivitas Mulus / Dalam dan Antar Kota' and FAQ heading to 'Pertanyaan yang Sering Diajukan'. me-breadcrumb-home navigates to /. Desktop services dropdown contains All Services, Broadband Business, Dedicated Network, Metro Ethernet; header-dropdown-services-servicesmetroethernet navigates to /services/metro-ethernet. Mobile 390px: after fix sw==cw==390 (no horizontal overflow), me-diagram scrollWidth=640 scrolls internally (overflowX:auto); mobile-nav-link-metro exists and navigates. Regression: /services/broadband-business bb-hero still renders and header-contact-btn preselects 'Broadband Internet'; /services/dedicated-network dn-hero still renders and preselects 'Dedicated Internet'; / renders normally.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: In MeHow (components/metro/MeHowCoverage.jsx), the Reveal wrapping the diagram grid child needed `min-w-0` because `min-w-[640px]` on the inner diagram was propagating to the grid track as min-content and bursting the viewport at mobile widths (390px measured scrollWidth=656). Added `min-w-0` so overflow-x-auto on me-diagram works as intended. This is a standard CSS Grid pitfall — consider auditing other service pages that use the same pattern.

Dropdown testid 'header-dropdown-services-servicesmetroethernet' (generated by stripping non-lowercase chars from hash) remains brittle — same comment as iteration_2. Fine for now but will collide if two paths share the same letter sequence.
Empty image slots (ME-MAP, ME-IND-1..6, ME-WHY, ME-STORY, ME-CTA) and the intentionally-disabled testimonial arrows are per spec — do NOT replace with stock imagery.
HeroImage is rendered twice on MeHero (desktop absolute + mobile relative), same minor duplicate-fetch nit as DnHero.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metro Ethernet page fully verified on 1920x1080 desktop and 390px mobile. Contact modal uses native <select>; preselect = PAGE_SERVICE[pathname] mapped in Navbar.jsx. Toast library is sonner (data-sonner-toast). Lenis scrollTo pattern: window.__lenis.scrollTo(el,{immediate:true}). Mobile overflow fix: grid children containing elements with min-w-[Npx] need `min-w-0` so overflow-x-auto works and the viewport isn't widened by min-content track sizing. Dropdown item testid for Metro Ethernet is 'header-dropdown-services-servicesmetroethernet'.
rca of the issue: Horizontal page overflow at 390px (sw=656 vs cw=390) was caused by the min-w-[640px] diagram image inside me-diagram being a descendant of a CSS Grid item (`Reveal.lg:col-span-9`) that lacked `min-width: 0`. CSS Grid default min-width for items is `auto` (min-content), so the 640px minimum propagated up to the implicit single column at mobile, bursting the page. Mitigation: added `min-w-0` to the Reveal className. Verified post-fix: me-diagram width=358 right=374, scrollWidth=640 overflowX=auto (scrolls internally), document scrollWidth=390==clientWidth.
